macros.name: AddToKeyvalOption
macros.doc: The code for an existing key ⟨key⟩ of family ⟨family⟩ is extended by code ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: CurrentOptionKey
macros.doc: \CurrentOptionKey contains the key of the key value pair, or the whole option string, if it misses the equal sign.

macros.name: CurrentOptionValue
macros.doc: \CurrentOptionValue contains the value part if the option string is parsable as key value pair, otherwise it is \relax.

macros.name: DeclareBoolOption
macros.doc: A boolean switch is generated, initialized by value ⟨init⟩ and the corresponding key ⟨key⟩ is defined.

macros.name: DeclareDefaultOption
macros.doc: This command does not define a specific key, it is the equivalent to LaTeX’s \DeclareOption*. It allows the specification of a default action ⟨code⟩ that is invoked if an unknown option is found.

macros.name: DeclareStringOption
macros.doc: A macro is created that remembers the value of the key ⟨key⟩.

macros.name: DisableKeyvalOption
macros.doc: \DisableKeyvalOption can be called to mark the end when the option ⟨key⟩ is no longer useful.

macros.name: ProcessKeyvalOptions
macros.doc: This command evaluates the global or local options of the package that are defined with keyval’s interface within the family ⟨family⟩.
